```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
Nanopore_sequencing <- read.csv("/bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Nanopore_Huh7_fusions/jaffa_results.csv", header = TRUE) %>% mutate(library_type = case_when(grepl('FBA22517|FBA22660', sample)  ~ "direct_RNA",
                                                        grepl('FAZ', sample)  ~ "PCR_cDNA",
                                                        grepl('FBA62655|FBA43334', sample)  ~ "direct_cDNA"),
                               RNA_sample = case_when(grepl('FAZ80247|FBA62655|FBA22660', sample)  ~ "Huh7_p9_8_7_B1",
                                                        grepl('FBA22517|FAZ83542|FBA43334', sample) ~ "Huh7_p9_8_7_B2"),
                               Platform = "ONT")

Illumina_sequencing_IllHB1<- read.csv("/bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/Illumina_NovaSeq/fastp_trimmed/Huh7B1_JAFFA_direct_analysis/jaffa_direct_Huh7B1.csv", header = TRUE) %>% mutate(library_type = "PCR_cDNA",
                               RNA_sample = "Huh7_p9_8_7_B1",
                               Platform = "Illumina")
Illumina_sequencing_IllHB2<- read.csv("/bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/Illumina_NovaSeq/fastp_trimmed/JAFFA_direct_analysis/Huh7B2_direct/jaffa_direct_Huh7B2.csv", header = TRUE) %>% mutate(library_type = "PCR_cDNA",
                               RNA_sample = "Huh7_p9_8_7_B2",
                               Platform = "Illumina")
Illumina_sequencing <- rbind(Illumina_sequencing_IllHB1, Illumina_sequencing_IllHB2)

PacBio_Sequencing <- read.csv("/bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/PacBio_Revio_full_length_cDNA/jaffa_results.csv", header = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(library_type = "PCR_cDNA", 
         RNA_sample = case_when(grepl('B1', sample)  ~ "Huh7_p9_8_7_B1", 
                                grepl('B2', sample)  ~  "Huh7_p9_8_7_B2"), 
         Platform = "PacBio")

Huh7_JAFFAL <- rbind(Illumina_sequencing, Nanopore_sequencing, PacBio_Sequencing)
```

```{r}
#import tri-gene results
PacBio_Sequencing_3Gene <- rbind(mutate(read.table("/bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/PacBio_Revio_full_length_cDNA/PB1_FLNCcDNA.fastq/PB1_FLNCcDNA.fastq.3gene_summary", header = TRUE), sample = "PB1_FLNCcDNA.fastq") , mutate(read.table("/bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/PacBio_Revio_full_length_cDNA/PB2_FLNCcDNA.fastq/PB2_FLNC.fastq.3gene_summary", header = TRUE), sample = "PB2_FLNCcDNA.fastq" ))%>% 
  mutate(library_type = "PCR_cDNA", 
         RNA_sample = case_when(grepl('B1', sample)  ~ "Huh7_p9_8_7_B1", 
                                grepl('B2', sample)  ~  "Huh7_p9_8_7_B2"), 
         Platform = "PacBio")

Tri_gene <- list.files(path="/bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark", pattern = "3gene_summary", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) 
Nano_3gene <- Tri_gene[grepl("Nanopore_Huh7_fusionschopper_filtered", Tri_gene)]
name <- 0
for (location in Nano_3gene){
  name <- name + 1
  assign(paste0("file_", name), mutate(read.table(location, header = TRUE), sample = location, library_type = case_when(grepl('FBA22517|FBA22660', sample)  ~ "direct_RNA",
                                                        grepl('FAZ', sample)  ~ "PCR_cDNA",
                                                        grepl('FBA62655|FBA43334', sample)  ~ "direct_cDNA"),
                               RNA_sample = case_when(grepl('FAZ80247|FBA62655|FBA22660', sample)  ~ "Huh7_p9_8_7_B1",
                                                        grepl('FBA22517|FAZ83542|FBA43334', sample) ~ "Huh7_p9_8_7_B2"),
                               Platform = "ONT"))
} 

Nanopore_sequencing_3Gene <- rbind(file_1, file_2, file_3, file_4, file_5, file_6)

Huh7_JAFFAL_3Gene <- rbind(PacBio_Sequencing_3Gene, Nanopore_sequencing_3Gene)
```

```{r}
#filtering our rRNA fusions and low read support fusions
obvious_library_chimeras <- Huh7_JAFFAL %>%
  filter(!grepl("^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y)", chrom1) | #non-genomic chromosomes and scaffolds
         !grepl("^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y)", chrom2))
lowread_Huh7_JAFFAL <- Huh7_JAFFAL %>% filter((spanning.pairs==0 & spanning.reads==1) |(spanning.pairs==1 & spanning.reads==0)) #fusions supported by only one spanning read or one spanning pair

filtered_Huh7_JAFFAL <- Huh7_JAFFAL %>%
  filter(grepl("^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y)", chrom1) |
         grepl("^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y)", chrom2)) %>%
  filter((spanning.pairs>=0 & spanning.reads>=2) |(spanning.pairs>=2 & spanning.reads>=0))

filtered_Huh7_JAFFAL_3Gene <- Huh7_JAFFAL_3Gene %>%
  filter(Reads>=2)
```

```{r}
#number of fusions
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(filtered_Huh7_JAFFAL)+
  geom_point(aes(x=spanning.pairs, y=spanning.reads, colour=Platform, shape=library_type))

ggplot(filtered_Huh7_JAFFAL) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill=RNA_sample, x=Platform), position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")) +
  scale_y_log10()
  
ggplot(filtered_Huh7_JAFFAL, aes(x = interaction(library_type, Platform), fill = RNA_sample)) +
  geom_bar(position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")) +
  scale_y_log10()+
  coord_flip()

ggplot(filtered_Huh7_JAFFAL_3Gene) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill=RNA_sample, x=Platform), position = position_dodge(preserve = "single"))
  

bar_data <- filtered_Huh7_JAFFAL %>%
  count(library_type, Platform, RNA_sample) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% rename(number_of_fusions = n)

```

```{bash Aligning Reads}
#need to rerun
for input_file in /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh-7_Library_Comparison/*/*/*.fastq.gz /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh-7_Library_Comparision_PCR-cDNA/*/*/*.fastq.gz /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh7_Library_Comparison_direct_cDNA/*/*/*.fastq.gz /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/PacBio_Revio_full_length_cDNA/*.fastq.gz; do
  file_prefix=$(basename "$input_file" .fastq.gz)
  /opt/JAFFA-version-2.3/tools/bin/minimap2 -t 4 -ax splice /opt/JAFFA-version-2.3/hg38_genCode47.fa $input_file | samtools view -@ 8 -b | samtools sort -@ 8 -o /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/${file_prefix}.sorted.bam 
  
done

/opt/JAFFA-version-2.3/tools/bin/bowtie2 --very-fast -p 10 -x /opt/JAFFA-version-2.3/hg38_genCode47 -1 /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/Illumina_NovaSeq/fastp_trimmed/Huh7_B1_22T7FFLT3_CATTAGTGCG-TGACTACATA_R1.fastq.gz -2 /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/Illumina_NovaSeq/fastp_trimmed/Huh7_B1_22T7FFLT3_CATTAGTGCG-TGACTACATA_R2.fastq.gz -S /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh7_B1_Illumina.sam
samtools view -@ 4 -bS /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh7_B1_Illumina.sam | samtools sort -@ 4 -o /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh7_B1_Illumina.sorted.bam &

/opt/JAFFA-version-2.3/tools/bin/bowtie2 --very-fast -p 10 -x /opt/JAFFA-version-2.3/hg38_genCode47 -1 /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/Illumina_NovaSeq/fastp_trimmed/Huh7_B2_22T7FFLT3_ACGGTCAGGA-CGGCCTCGTT_R1.fastq.gz -2 /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/AGRF_Sequencing_Data/Illumina_NovaSeq/fastp_trimmed/Huh7_B2_22T7FFLT3_ACGGTCAGGA-CGGCCTCGTT_R2.fastq.gz -S /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh7_B2_Illumina.sam
samtools view -@ 4 -bS /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh7_B2_Illumina.sam | samtools sort -@ 4 -o /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh7_B2_Illumina.sorted.bam 

wait

rm -rv /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh7_B1_Illumina.sam
rm -rv /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/Huh7_B2_Illumina.sam
ls -lht /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/*bam

wget https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_47/gencode.v47.annotation.gtf.gz -O ~/reference_files/gencode.v47.annotation.gtf.gz
gunzip ~/reference_files/gencode.v47.annotation.gtf.gz
```

```{bash}
conda create --name Subread_env bioconda::subread
conda activate Subread_env
featureCounts -v
featureCounts -a ~/reference_files/gencode.v47.annotation.gtf -o LongReadLibraries.counts.txt -M -O -T 8 -g gene_id -L /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/*cDNA.sorted.bam /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/*pass*sorted.bam

featureCounts -a ~/reference_files/gencode.v47.annotation.gtf -o ShortReadLibraries.counts.txt -M -O -T 8 -g gene_id -p --countReadPairs  /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/*Illumina*.sorted.bam
conda deactivate Subread_env
```

multiqc ./ /bioinformatics/ryley/Library_Benchmark/
